messages.text: Brilliant sprinter Almeraq retired to stud

metadata.summary: Champion sprinter-elect Almeraq has been retired to stand at Shadwell's Beech House Stud for 2027.
metadata.content: Brilliant sprinter Almeraq retired to stud | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Brilliant sprinter Almeraq retired to stud Less than a week on from his brilliant exploits in the Champions Sprint, Shadwell Stud have made the decision to retire Almeraq. Wednesday 21 October 2026 18:16, UK Image: Tom Marquand and Almeraq enter the winners' enclosure Champion sprinter-elect Almeraq has been retired to stand at Shadwell's Beech House Stud for 2027. Winner of three six-furlong Group Ones this season for William Haggas and Tom Marquand, that would be a a remarkable season in any book before even considering what happened to him at the end of the 2025 season. Running in a Listed race at York in September he clipped heels and took a very heavy fall. Connections feared the worst yet while the horses emerged generally unscathed, neither jockey involved, the now-retired Jim Crowley or Trevor Whelan, have ridden since. For Almeraq to bounce back this season to not only win races but at the very highest level, shows another side to his character. Ombudsman strikes Champion Stakes gold | Full replay Darkness Falls strikes Dewhurst gold for O'Brien The four-year-old by Dark Angel won the Queen Elizabeth II Jubilee Stakes at Royal Ascot, the Haydock Sprint Cup by over four lengths and on Saturday he took the British Champions Sprint. metadata.content: Johnny Fisher will reach "another level" for next fight, says Zuffa Boxing's Dana White | Charles Martin wants Fisher fight | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Johnny Fisher will reach "another level" for next fight, says Zuffa Boxing's Dana White | Charles Martin wants Fisher fight Zuffa Boxing promoter Dana White expects Johnny Fisher to reach a new level for his next fight as he invites him to use the UFC Performance Institute in Las Vegas; Fisher won a draining bout in his Zuffa debut in September; former world champion Charles Martin is open to fighting Fisher Wednesday 21 October 2026 15:34, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Michael Pirotton mocks Johnny Fisher after he got hit with a huge right hand! Johnny Fisher will reach “another level” for his next fight, says Zuffa Boxing founder Dana White. Fisher had his first bout with new promoter Zuffa Boxing in September, coming through a draining 10-round battle with Michael Pirotton. "He looked good until he started gassing out in the last couple of rounds. But he fought through it, won the fight and I'm excited to see him fight again. He's fun, the crowd is fun, his family are good, fun people and I love having him a part of Zuffa Boxing," White told Sky Sports . messages.text: Conan, Doris, Crowley absent from Ireland's Nations Championship squad

metadata.summary: Andy Farrell's Ireland will head into November's Nations Championship without injured trio Jack Conan, Caelan Doris and Jack Crowley, but Jamison Gibson-Park has been included.
metadata.content: Nations Championship: Ireland without injured trio Jack Conan, Caelan Doris, Jack Crowley but Jamison Gibson-Park included | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Nations Championship: Ireland without injured trio Jack Conan, Caelan Doris, Jack Crowley but Jamison Gibson-Park included Jack Conan, Caelan Doris and Jack Crowley will miss Ireland’s Nations Championship Tests against Argentina, Fiji and South Africa next month due to injury; Jamison Gibson-Park has been included despite his recent groin problem, while Mack Hansen and Andrew Porter return to the squad Michael Cantillon Sports Journalist Wednesday 21 October 2026 16:44, UK Image: Jack Conan (left) and Caelan Doris (right) have both been ruled out of Ireland's Nations Championship Tests in November through injury Andy Farrell's Ireland will head into November's Nations Championship without injured trio Jack Conan, Caelan Doris and Jack Crowley, but Jamison Gibson-Park has been included. Ireland face Tests against Argentina, Fiji and South Africa next month without captain Caelan Doris and fly-half Jack Crowley, who are both expected to return from long-term injuries in January. Doris has been sidelined by foot and knee problems, while Crowley is recovering from a vascular issue in his leg. Conan, who like Doris plays at No 8, is also ruled out after injuring his shoulder while playing for Leinster in the Champions Cup last weekend.
